reason: The cited lines define list_organizations as a read-only tool whose execute handler returns {organizations: await e.listOrganizations()}, with output fields id, slug, and name and a description saying it lists organizations the user is a member of. That establishes it returns user/account SaaS data into the agent context, so SECRET is supported. There is no indication of arbitrary host code execution or sending agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination, so HOSTEXEC and SINK are not supported. Although organization names/slugs may in practice be user-controlled, these lines alone do not establish attacker control over the returned content, so UNTRUSTED is insufficient.
